answer: In the PoA graph, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust matrix, while reputation decays with an exponential half-life. Sustained honest service is required to rebuild score over time; freshly spawned sybil identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality because no established peers endorse them, so transitivity cannot amplify their influence. Thus a beacon, willow, or mesa identity remains below consensus thresholds and cannot pass consensus until durable reciprocal evidence accumulates.
